text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces errors. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees organise their work, write emails faster and analyse data more easily. However, AI does not replace people completely. Human-AI collaboration is becoming common, as workers use AI to support their decisions while adding creativity and judgement. These changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, but new ones are appearing, and many existing jobs are shifting towards skills like problem-solving and digital literacy. To succeed, employees need to keep learning and adapt to new technology.
